items.title: CMS makes it official, codifying Medicare drug price negotiations established under IRA
items.snippet: Against a backdrop of repeated industry challenges in court, the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services is locking in the drug price negotiation framework established under the Biden-era Inflation Reduction Act.
items.line: CMS officially codifies Medicare drug price negotiation rules under the Inflation Reduction Act, locking in framework despite repeated industry legal challenges.
